# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# O(7) Yearly Seven Cultural Capitals Evaluation
# Strictly guarded: has_owner = yes before EVERY owner read; is_rebel_country = no.

oe_cul2_grant_regional_beacon = {
	add_country_modifier = {
		modifier = $mod$
		months = 15
		mode = replace
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			current_year >= 1346
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_cul2_first_beacon_notified }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_cul2_ev_stagger_cd }
		}
		set_variable = oe_cul2_first_beacon_notified
		set_variable = { name = oe_cul2_ev_stagger_cd value = 1 years = 3 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul2_cap.9
	}
}

oe_cul2_evaluate_seven_capitals = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_cul2_cap_year value = current_year }

	set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_s1 value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_s2 value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_s3 value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_s4 value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_s5 value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_s6 value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_s7 value = 0 }

	if = {
		limit = { location:constantinople = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } }
		location:constantinople = { set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_s1 value = oe_cul2_capital_score } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location:rome = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } }
		location:rome = { set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_s2 value = oe_cul2_capital_score } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location:paris = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } }
		location:paris = { set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_s3 value = oe_cul2_capital_score } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location:dadu = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } }
		location:dadu = { set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_s4 value = oe_cul2_capital_score } }
	}

		limit = { location:cairo = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } }
		location:cairo = { set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_s5 value = oe_cul2_capital_score } }
	}

		limit = { location:samarkand = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } }
		location:samarkand = { set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_s6 value = oe_cul2_capital_score } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location:moscow = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } }
		location:moscow = { set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_s7 value = oe_cul2_capital_score } }
	}

	# --- 5 Macro-Regional Beacons of Civilization ---
	# 1. Mediterranean Beacon (Constantinople vs Rome)
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:oe_cul2_s1 >= local_var:oe_cul2_s2
			local_var:oe_cul2_s1 >= 25
			location:constantinople = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } }
		}
		location:constantinople = {
			owner = { oe_cul2_grant_regional_beacon = { mod = oe_cul2_beacon_mediterranean_mod } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:oe_cul2_s2 >= 25
			location:rome = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } }
		}
		location:rome = {
			owner = { oe_cul2_grant_regional_beacon = { mod = oe_cul2_beacon_mediterranean_mod } }
		}
	}

	# 2. Western European Beacon (Paris)
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:oe_cul2_s3 >= 25
			location:paris = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } }
		}
		location:paris = {
			owner = { oe_cul2_grant_regional_beacon = { mod = oe_cul2_beacon_western_mod } }
		}
	}

	# 3. East Asian Beacon (Dadu)
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:oe_cul2_s4 >= 25
			location:dadu = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } }
		}
		location:dadu = {
			owner = { oe_cul2_grant_regional_beacon = { mod = oe_cul2_beacon_east_asia_mod } }
		}
	}

	# 4. Islamic World Beacon (Cairo vs Samarkand)
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:oe_cul2_s5 >= local_var:oe_cul2_s6
			local_var:oe_cul2_s5 >= 25
			location:cairo = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } }
		}
		location:cairo = {
			owner = { oe_cul2_grant_regional_beacon = { mod = oe_cul2_beacon_islamic_mod } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:oe_cul2_s6 >= 25
			location:samarkand = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } }
		}
		location:samarkand = {
			owner = { oe_cul2_grant_regional_beacon = { mod = oe_cul2_beacon_islamic_mod } }

	}

	# 5. Eastern European & Steppe Beacon (Moscow)
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:oe_cul2_s7 >= 25
			location:moscow = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } }

			owner = { oe_cul2_grant_regional_beacon = { mod = oe_cul2_beacon_eastern_mod } }
		}

	# --- Global World Cultural Capital (O(7) Argmax) ---
	set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_best_score value = 24 }
	set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_best_id value = 0 }

	if = {
		limit = { local_var:oe_cul2_s1 > local_var:oe_cul2_best_score }
		set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_best_score value = local_var:oe_cul2_s1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_best_id value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:oe_cul2_s2 > local_var:oe_cul2_best_score }
		set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_best_score value = local_var:oe_cul2_s2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_best_id value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:oe_cul2_s3 > local_var:oe_cul2_best_score }
		set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_best_score value = local_var:oe_cul2_s3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_best_id value = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:oe_cul2_s4 > local_var:oe_cul2_best_score }
		set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_best_score value = local_var:oe_cul2_s4 }

	}
	if = {

		set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_best_score value = local_var:oe_cul2_s5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_best_id value = 5 }
	}

		limit = { local_var:oe_cul2_s6 > local_var:oe_cul2_best_score }
		set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_best_score value = local_var:oe_cul2_s6 }

	}

		set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_best_score value = local_var:oe_cul2_s7 }
		set_local_variable = { name = oe_cul2_best_id value = 7 }
	}

	# Apply World Cultural Capital crown & fire transition events if leader changed
	if = {

# Location scope (caller guarantees has_owner = yes and owner is not rebel)
oe_cul2_crown_world_capital = {
	add_location_modifier = {
		modifier = oe_cul2_beacon_city_loc_mod
		months = 15
		mode = replace
	}
	owner = {
		save_scope_as = oe_cul2_new_leader
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_cul2_world_cultural_capital_mod
			months = 15
			mode = replace
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1350
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cul2_ev_stagger_cd }
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cul2_world_leader_id }
					AND = {
						has_global_variable = oe_cul2_world_leader_id
						trigger_if = {
							limit = { has_global_variable = oe_cul2_world_leader_id }
							global_var:oe_cul2_world_leader_id != $id$
						}
					}
				}
			}
			# Notify displaced former crown-holder if a different valid country
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = oe_cul2_world_leader_country }
				global_var:oe_cul2_world_leader_country ?= {
					if = {
						limit = {
							is_rebel_country = no
							this != scope:oe_cul2_new_leader
							NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_cul2_dethroned_cd }
						}
						add_cooldown = { type = oe_cul2_dethroned_cd years = 10 }
						trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul2_cap.8
					}
				}
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_cul2_world_leader_id value = $id$ }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_cul2_world_leader_country value = scope:oe_cul2_new_leader }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_cul2_crown_ev_cd } }
				add_cooldown = { type = oe_cul2_crown_ev_cd years = 10 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_cul2_ev_stagger_cd value = 1 years = 3 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = $ev$
			}
		}
	}
}

# Lightweight yearly hybridization arc dispatcher (country scope, strictly rebel-guarded)
oe_cul2_hybridization_yearly_check = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_cul2_hyb_arc_cd } }
		if = {
			limit = { oe_cul2_hyb1_eligible = yes }
			set_variable = oe_cul2_hyb1_done
			add_cooldown = { type = oe_cul2_hyb_arc_cd years = 15 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul2_hyb.1
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_cul2_hyb2_eligible = yes }
			set_variable = oe_cul2_hyb2_done
			add_cooldown = { type = oe_cul2_hyb_arc_cd years = 15 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul2_hyb.2
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_cul2_hyb3_eligible = yes }
			set_variable = oe_cul2_hyb3_done
			add_cooldown = { type = oe_cul2_hyb_arc_cd years = 15 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul2_hyb.3
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_cul2_hyb4_eligible = yes }
			set_variable = oe_cul2_hyb4_done
			add_cooldown = { type = oe_cul2_hyb_arc_cd years = 15 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul2_hyb.4
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_cul2_hyb5_eligible = yes }
			set_variable = oe_cul2_hyb5_done
			add_cooldown = { type = oe_cul2_hyb_arc_cd years = 15 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul2_hyb.5
		}
	}
}
